name: Kwame Raoul
stance: Presses AI companies on child safety through multistate AG action.

statements.text: Co-led the 44-AG NAAG letter warning AI companies they will answer for harms to children.

Now more than ever, we need to cautiously adapt to a world with artificial intelligence, which is why it must be immediately regulated through legislation that protects our country's infrastructure and national security.
Children are not guinea pigs. I urge AI developers to prioritize the safety of children in Illinois and across the country when using their applications.
statements.outlet: Office of the Illinois Attorney General

statements.text: Joined a bipartisan 36-AG letter urging Congress not to insert a ban on state AI laws into the NDAA.
